title: 12-Round KNOT-256 Differential Characteristic Existence
summary: The ten dominant characteristics have zero probability, while the search found no qualifying characteristic; whether any exists remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the 12-round KNOT-256 differential has a characteristic with average probability at least $2^{-70}$ and nonzero probability under the default round constants.

scope.domain: Differential cryptanalysis of KNOT-256 in the fixed-key model.
assumptions: The default round constants are used.
parameters: KNOT-256 differential: the differential object under study
Average probability: threshold of at least 2^-70
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether a characteristic satisfying both probability conditions exists under the default round constants; the reported search does not prove nonexistence.

citations.label: Differential Cryptanalysis in the Fixed-Key Model

progress.summary: The source establishes zero probability for each of the ten dominant characteristics and reports no characteristic meeting the threshold with nonzero probability. It consequently says the related forgery and collision attacks are unlikely to be valid, without proving their invalidity.
citation_labels: Tim Beyne et al., Differential Cryptanalysis in the Fixed-Key Model
